en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an extremely ornate stone or wood church pulpit in a Gothic-style interior. The pulpit base is surrounded by swirling vegetal forms, cherubs and seated figures, with a spiral staircase winding up to a large, cup-shaped preaching platform decorated with bishops and saints in high relief. In the background are pointed-arch windows, tracery railings, statues, and other ecclesiastical furnishings. The image has the look of an old printed postcard, but no visible caption or writing appears on the front.
